versions.changelog:
Initial release of Industrial Brutalist UI skill.

- Defines two distinct UI archetypes: Swiss Industrial Print (light, grid-based, red accents) and Tactical Telemetry & CRT Terminal (dark, monospaced, technical).
- Establishes precise typographic rules for macro (heavy sans-serif), micro (monospace), and contrasting serif elements.
- Enforces strict, utilitarian color palettes; no gradients or rounded corners allowed.
- Details rigid layout systems using CSS Grid, visible compartmentalization, and bimodal density.
- Introduces unique UI elements like ASCII framing, industrial symbols, mechanical markers, and analog degradation effects (halftone, CRT scanlines, noise).
- Provides clear engineering directives for consistent, mechanical-feeling interfaces.
